name: frostsworn-paladin-intercept-not-offered-while-rested
notes: Frostsworn Paladin (rpOaAjgtue): the Intercept only works "while this ally is awake". The Paladin is seeded rested (Status 1); player 2's Dungeon Guide attacks player 1's champion and no interceptor prompt is offered: the champion takes the 1 damage itself.

rulesClauses: Intercept works only while this ally is awake: a rested Paladin cannot intercept.
